description: Call this before you recommend, add, or vouch for a dependency, and whenever you are about to say whether a package is maintained. Your training data has a cutoff: a package that looked healthy in it may have lost its maintainer or gone quiet since, and nothing in you will flag that. Pass every package you are weighing in one call -- a shortlist, a manifest, a lockfile. A package already analysed comes back with its risk now. One that is not is queued and comes back "pending": call again with the same packages in a minute or two. Asking about a pending package again is not charged.
name: check_packages
title: Check packages
